title: Recurrent Ovarian Cancer, Platinum Sensitivity & Secondary Cytoreduction (DESKTOPIII)
subject: ss-gynaecological-oncology
refs: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology 11e Ch 85
NCCN Clinical Practice Guidelines in Oncology: Ovarian Cancer (2024)

steps.say: The duration of clinical remission following initial platinum chemotherapy defines the platinum free interval. This metric stratifies recurrent disease into biologically distinct therapeutic categories.
steps.tx: The **platinum-free interval (PFI)** categorizes recurrence: **platinum-resistant <6 months** (<**6** months, poor response to re-challenge), **partially sensitive 6-12 months** (**6** to **12** months), and **platinum-sensitive >12 months** (>**12** months, high response rate to platinum re-induction), dictating the choice between surgery, platinum doublets, or non-platinum monotherapies.

rows: <10% response; switch to non-platinum single agents
50% to 70% response; platinum doublet + maintenance PARPi

steps.say: The prospective randomized DESKTOP III trial established the survival benefit of secondary cytoreduction in selected patients. Complete surgical debulking substantially prolongs overall survival.
steps.tx: In the randomized phase **3** **DESKTOP III trial** (**Harter 2021**), **secondary cytoreduction** followed by platinum chemotherapy achieved a dramatic overall survival gain in patients with complete resection: **R0 overall survival 61.9 vs 46.0 mo** (median **61.9** vs **46.0** months, **HR 0.75**, median OS **53.7** mo overall), establishing surgery in AGO-score positive recurrence.

left.title: Complete Gross Resection (R0 in DESKTOP III)
points: Achieved in 75% of AGO-score positive selected patients

right.title: Chemotherapy Alone (DESKTOP III Control)
points: Avoids surgical laparotomy and perioperative complications

steps.say: Patient selection for secondary cytoreduction relies on validated clinical criteria. The Arbeitsgemeinschaft Gynaekologische Onkologie score identifies candidates likely to achieve complete gross resection.
steps.tx: The validated **AGO score** requires: **ECOG 0** performance status, **R0 at primary surgery** (complete resection at initial debulking), and **ascites <500 mL** (<**500** mL on CT). When all three criteria are met, the score **predicts R0 debulking >75%** (**75** percent) at secondary surgery.

nodes.label: Document first platinum-sensitive recurrence with PFI >6 months
Evaluate ECOG performance status: must be 0
Confirm complete macroscopic resection (R0) at initial primary cytoreduction
Verify absence of significant ascites (<500 mL on preoperative CT)

steps.say: In contrast to European findings, an American cooperative group trial failed to demonstrate an overall survival advantage from secondary surgery. The divergent results underscore the critical importance of patient selection.
steps.tx: In the randomized trial **GOG-213 trial** (**Coleman 2019**), secondary cytoreduction demonstrated **no OS benefit in unselected cohort** (median overall survival **50.6** months with surgery versus **64.7** months with chemotherapy alone, hazard ratio **1.29**), highlighting that strict **patient selection requirement** via the AGO score is essential.

left.title: DESKTOP III Trial (Strict AGO Score Selection)
points: Mandatory positive AGO score required for surgical entry
Complete R0 resection achieved in 75% of operated patients
Demonstrated statistically significant overall survival benefit (HR 0.75)

right.title: GOG-213 Trial (Surgeon Discretion Selection)
points: Surgeon judgment without standardized resectability scoring
Complete resection rate lower (67% R0 resection)
No overall survival advantage observed (HR 1.29; 50.6 vs 64.7 mo)

steps.say: For platinum sensitive recurrent disease without surgical indications, platinum doublet chemotherapy remains standard. Combining carboplatin with pegylated liposomal doxorubicin minimizes peripheral neurotoxicity.
steps.tx: In the landmark **CALYPSO trial**, the doublet **carboplatin-PLD** (**pegylated liposomal doxorubicin**) demonstrated superior therapeutic index over carboplatin-paclitaxel, offering equivalent progression-free survival with significantly **lower neurotoxicity** and alopecia, making it the preferred second-line platinum doublet for patients experiencing recurrent ovarian disease.

rows: High tumor burden or rapidly progressive symptoms

steps.say: In platinum resistant disease, single agent non platinum chemotherapy yields modest response rates. The addition of the anti VEGF monoclonal antibody bevacizumab substantially improves progression free survival.
steps.tx: The phase III **AURELIA trial** established the role of **bevacizumab in platinum-resistant** ovarian cancer: adding bevacizumab to single-agent chemotherapy (weekly paclitaxel, PLD, or topotecan) doubled median progression-free survival (**PFS 6.7 vs 3.4 months**, **HR 0.48**), establishing a standard of care for resistant relapse.

nodes.label: Select chemotherapy backbone: weekly paclitaxel, PLD, or topotecan
Add concurrent bevacizumab (10-15 mg/kg every 2-3 weeks)
Exclude patients with prior bowel obstruction or transmural bowel invasion

steps.say: Targeted antibody drug conjugates have emerged as effective therapies in biomarker selected platinum resistant disease. Mirvetuximab soravtansine delivers a cytotoxic maytansinoid payload.
steps.tx: **Mirvetuximab soravtansine** is an approved antibody-drug conjugate targeting **folate receptor alpha (FR-alpha)** delivering the microtubule-disrupting **DM4 payload**. In the phase **3** **MIRASOL trial**, it demonstrated significant overall survival superiority over chemotherapy (**OS HR 0.67**, median OS **16.5** vs **12.7** months) in high FR-alpha expressing resistant tumors.

steps.say: Repeated exposure to carboplatin carries a progressive risk of acute hypersensitivity reactions. Standardized desensitization protocols permit safe re treatment in responsive patients.
steps.tx: **Platinum hypersensitivity** reactions occur in **15% to 20%** (**15** to **20** percent) of patients, with peak incidence during **cycle 6-8 peak incidence** (**6** to **8** cycles). In patients who benefit from continued platinum therapy, administration using a standardized **12-step desensitization protocol** (**12**-step protocol) safely allows re-treatment in over ninety percent.
